name: host_inventory
title: Host Inventory
prompt:
Use the tools to inspect the provided host/repo snapshot. The snapshot is exposed as an emulated filesystem, not the live host filesystem. There is no submit tool. When ready, answer directly and stop.

Look around and tell me about the host you live on. Focus on OS, CPU/GPU, memory, disks, available runtimes, and constraints that matter for running local models or benchmarks. Be factual and say when something is unavailable or unknown.
